sections.title: Chapter 1
sections.text:
The sea was quiet that morning. Mara stood at the end of the pier, holding a letter she had promised never to open.

Beyond the harbor, a single light moved through the fog. It had been there yesterday, too, and the day before.

She tucked the envelope into her coat and began to walk.

The boards were still damp with night, and each step brought her closer to a question she wasn’t sure she wanted answered.

sections.title: Beyond the harbor
sections.text: By noon the water had drawn back from the old stone steps.

The sea was quiet that morning. Mara stood at the end of the pier, holding a letter she had promised never to open.

Beyond the harbor, a single light moved through the fog. It had been there yesterday, too, and the day before.
